plugins.name: qoq
plugins.description: Quality toolkit for JavaScript/TypeScript repos — `fix`, `refactor`, `bump`, `plan`, `replan`, `execute`, `test`, `compress`. Use it whenever the user wants lint or formatting cleaned up, dead code or dead dependencies removed, a branch checked before merge, duplication refactored, npm dependencies bumped, a spec broken into tickets, an existing plan reshaped or re-decomposed after it stalled or the requirements moved, an approved plan executed or resumed — from a plan file or a Jira, Linear or Trello milestone — tests written for code that already exists, or agent-facing markdown (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, skill docs) made terser to stop burning context. Trigger it even when the user never says "qoq" or names a tool.
